syntheticSurfaces.corsPreflight: Middleware handles OPTIONS with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method. A future narrow preflight exception may negotiate CORS only; it must not dispatch a handler or grant identity. Ordinary OPTIONS is not an auth exemption.
syntheticSurfaces.slashRedirects: Starlette may redirect alternate trailing-slash spellings. Future auth must cover routing/redirects without putting credentials in a Location URL.
syntheticSurfaces.unmatchedRequests: 404/405 and unknown routes grant no authority. New routes, methods, handlers and mounts require explicit inventory review; there is no implicit public fallback.
